Subject: SIG intake: Oxley AI — scheduling call & evidence census

Hi Samira —

Thanks for the intro over LinkedIn — excited to kick off the SIG/CAIQ intake for Oxley. To make the 1st call productive, can we confirm a 45-minute slot next week? Available windows (PT):

- Wed 3 Sep, 9:00–10:00
- Thu 4 Sep, 13:00–13:45
- Fri 5 Sep, 10:00–10:45

Goal for the call: align scope (CAIQ vs SIG), review preliminary answers, and agree an evidence census (owners, sample windows, access to logs/tenants). Please include the security owner and someone who can grant temporary log access or a service account.

Prep I can share now: Redwood SIG intake template (attached), a short SOC 2 mapping doc, and a pre-call checklist below. If you can drop an initial evidence roster (simple CSV) into the Drive link I’ll share, that speeds things up.

Pre-call checklist (short):
- CAIQ/SIG draft (if available) or list of areas you want covered
- Names and emails for evidence owners (SSO, Logs, Infra, App)
- A sample log window (preferred: 7 days) and the location/method to pull it
- Any NDA/handling constraints for artifact delivery

Attachements: redwood-sig-intake-template.xlsx; redwood-soc2-mapping.pdf

If none of those windows work, propose alternatives and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,

Perfect — Fri 5 Sep 10:00 PT is on the calendar.

I’ve created a short prep packet and a calendar invite with a Google Meet link. For the pre-call, please confirm the following items into the Drive folder (link in calendar invite):
- CAIQ draft (PDF or XLSX) OR a list of the 5-7 highest-priority controls you want us to review
- Evidence owners (name + email) for App, Infra, Logging, IAM, and Data Retention
- A note on log retention windows and whether logs are centralized (CloudWatch/Stackdriver/Splunk/S3)
- Any encryption/KMS key ownership constraints (bring the KMS owner if possible)

Logistics on uploads: we accept Drive share or SFTP. If you prefer SFTP we’ll send a short SFTP instructions doc (SFTP user + expiry). For small artifacts DocuSign is fine for signed handling agreements.

I’ve attached the intake template again to this thread.

Thanks — Jordan will also join to take notes and capture action items.
